relations: Shiv 的真名是 River，是 Ophelia 的兄弟——谈供血时脱口说漏。
Dante 平时靠 Shiv 供血（咬手腕）；入狱初期与 Jazz 互喂，Shiv 与 Jazz 在一起后改为 Shiv 供血。
Dante 与 Ophelia 约定 good friend 式关系，出狱后互不再见。

facts.fact: Dante 建议她找炮友换保护——狱中男人会为身边的女人杀人。
facts.anchor: Men in the prison will kill to protect the woman they're with, consequences be damned.

facts.fact: 背包侧翻巨响但陶器没碎，Ophelia 解释施过防碎魔法（每件花几个月注入魔力）。
facts.anchor: My hiking backpack chose that moment to fall sideways. There was a crash, but I didn't hear anything break.

facts.fact: Ophelia 躺下调侃这将是很欢乐的十一个半小时，Dante 没笑。
facts.anchor: This is going to be a really fun eleven and a half hours

facts.fact: Dante 手搭她膝头，说最怀念政变前的安全感。
facts.anchor: That's what I miss the most. I felt secure, before the coup.

facts.fact: 谈供血时 Ophelia 脱口说出兄弟真名 River，Dante 并不惊讶。
facts.anchor: My brother's real name slipped out before I could stop it.

facts.fact: Dante 褪她背带，调侃这是十二年来第一次给这么亲近的女人脱牛仔背带裤。
facts.anchor: I can't believe I'm taking jean overalls off the first woman I've been this close to in twelve years

facts.fact: 第二次高潮时 Dante 獠牙刺入她大腿吸血。
facts.anchor: One of his fangs grazed my clit, and another climax tore through me so hard, I screamed.

facts.fact: 高潮后 Dante 拔牙舔平咬痕，夸她 fucking delicious。
facts.anchor: As I came down from the high, dazed and slightly dizzy, he pulled his fangs free and slowly licked the wounds he'd left.
